text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hey Creek, was the handkerchief by<n>my pillow
your present for me?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see you found it. Hehe, I thought<n>I'd surprise
you this year!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh my, is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
That was handmade, wasn't it? The<n>pattern and
embroidery are all<n>designed to look like my
racewear.<n>So, uh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Wasn't it a lot of work to make?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Not in the slightest. I kept imagining<n>your smiling
face while I was making<n>it, so it didn't feel like
work at all. ♪
